# DropSpace v0.3.0-preview.14 — Motion system and bounded Acrylic

<!-- update-summary: Preview.14 separates Dynamic Island motion channels, moves visual-only feedback to the compositor, deduplicates DPI-aware native regions, and adds bounded Windows 11 Desktop Acrylic fallbacks. -->

Preview.14 is a presentation and lifecycle hardening Preview. It preserves the Windows 10 version 1809 (Build 17763) baseline, Dynamic-Island-only boundary, Smart Drag fail-closed authorization, precise OLE hit-region ownership, source-safe actions, and local-first data contracts.

## Motion system

- Split geometry, surface opacity, content transition, interaction feedback, and elevation into separate profiles with bounded, interruptible spring semantics.
- Record state transition cause and motion preference in `OverlayTransitionDescriptor` so reversals, dismissals, drop feedback, monitor changes, and preference changes remain diagnosable.
- Use compositor-backed opacity, content fades, hover tint, and press feedback. The UI thread continues to own layout, lifecycle, and exact native geometry.
- Use the 0/83/167/250/333 ms token set; incoming content uses a short handoff delay and small offset, while outgoing content fades promptly.
- Reduced motion removes bounce, overshoot, noticeable scale, and unnecessary translation. Accepted-drop feedback compresses inward to 0.97 and returns to 1.0 without outward expansion.

## Acrylic and native geometry

- Add a bounded Windows 11 `SystemBackdropElement` using `DesktopAcrylicBackdrop` for the transient island only.
- Windows 10, unsupported backdrops, disabled advanced effects, and high contrast use a solid fallback with system-aware stroke/background resources.
- Deduplicate `SetWindowRgn` by a physical DPI-aware region signature and avoid repeated empty-region allocations at rest.
- Keep hidden idle input-free, no-activate/topmost behavior, no taskbar/Alt+Tab entry, exact OLE ownership, and the existing Windows 10 fallback path.

## Validation boundary

- Added Core tests for profile separation, reduced-motion bounds, inward drop confirmation, transition descriptors, and region-signature deduplication.
- The release remains **CONDITIONAL** until Windows CI/release packaging, real Windows 10/11 OS/DPI/multi-monitor/OLE/accessibility interaction, performance/GDI stability, and existing provider/network evidence are recorded. Linux Core tests do not substitute for those rows.
